findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name IP address validation bypass
 * @description Using ipaddress library incorrectly can lead to bypass of security restrictions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/ip-validation-bypass
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-20
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("ipaddress").getMember(["ip_address", "IPv4Address", "IPv6Address"]).getACall() and
  not exists(DataFlow::ExprNode arg | arg = call.getArg(0) and arg.toString().matches("%\"[0-9]\"%"))
select call, "Potential IP address validation bypass if input is not properly validated before parsing"
findings.hypothesis: IP address validation bypass through improper use of ipaddress library

message.text: Potential IP address validation bypass if input is not properly validated before parsing
